description: OKF Studio webview capabilities on every platform: store, opener, opt-in notifications, window controls, and pop-out creation. No webview dialog, filesystem, or general network API is granted; Rust owns explicit bundle, provider, source, installer, and agent operations. 'pop-*' covers reader windows with the same surface and no extra plugin grants. The updater and restart grants live in desktop.json, because those plugins are compiled out on Android.
